parsed.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large, well-lit warehouse aisle flanked by tall metal racks filled with stacked boxes. Yellow forklifts and pallet jacks are parked or moving along the aisle. Bright yellow safety bollards line the walkways. The concrete floor reflects overhead lights. Distant figures in red jackets are visible near the far end.

objects.label: warehouse rack
objects.observation: Tall black metal shelving units extending vertically on both sides of the aisle, holding multiple layers of white and brown boxes. Marked with yellow numbers '4' and '5'. Some sections have visible structural beams above.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Yellow and black forklift positioned on the left side of the aisle, partially cut off by the frame. Its rear is facing the camera, showing a black seat and control panel. It appears stationary near palletized goods.

objects.label: pallet jack
objects.observation: Yellow and black pallet jack located centrally in the aisle, facing away from the camera. It has a black seat and handlebar. It is parked between two racks, with its front wheels slightly turned.

objects.label: yellow safety bollard
objects.observation: Bright yellow cylindrical bollards with black bases, placed along the aisle edges to mark boundaries. They are evenly spaced and appear to be freestanding, some connected by horizontal yellow bars.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: Two individuals wearing red jackets walking down the aisle toward the background. They are small in the frame due to distance and appear to be moving away from the camera.

objects.label: stacked boxes
objects.observation: White cardboard boxes stacked on wooden pallets at the base of the racks. Some boxes have visible branding or labels. They are arranged neatly and supported by the pallets.
